##: Scoop manifest (dry run: integrations.yml installs it on a hosted runner from the CI release artifact; for a bucket only on the maintainer's go, after the repository is public). The zip is the release's PushMPC-<version>.zip (filter, core, the installer script); the installer script downloads Veyra's runtime package like Setup does. Uninstall puts every player setting back.
description: PushFPS video enhancement in media players: frame generation, RTX Video Super Resolution, scene-cut guard (MPC-HC, MPC-BE, PotPlayer, mpv family).

script: if (-not $stage) { throw 'PushMPC: filter\pushmpc-install.ps1 not found in the package' }
if (Test-Path $s) { & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $s uninstall; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "PushMPC uninstall failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" } }

notes: PushMPC is set up in the players it found. Settings: in the player (MPC-HC: Play > Filters > PushMPC Filter). Remove it with: scoop uninstall pushmpc
